mapper.insert: INSERT INTO train_runner_process (command_id, runner_id, pid, process_started_at, executable, arguments_sha256, status, exit_code, error_code, last_seen_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{commandId}, #{runnerId}, #{pid}, #{processStartedAt}, #{executable}, #{argumentsSha256}, #{status}, #{exitCode}, #{errorCode}, #{lastSeenAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT pid FROM train_runner_process WHERE runner_id = #{runnerId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
